subject: Billing sender authorization & delivery channel workplan
messages:
From: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenline AP <ap@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery options + VAT tagging (AP spec attached)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo earlier. Our AP team reviewed Redwood's billing docs and we need to lock down two things before go-live:

1) Who should Redwood list as the invoice sender and who should receive the invoice (we typically require the bill-to to match the PO remit).
2) Delivery channel: our preference is to receive invoices via our AP portal (file push/API), but we need an email copy for internal matching. If portal push isn't available at first, SFTP or PDF via email are acceptable fallbacks.

I've attached our AP spec with field names we require (vendor_name, remit_to_code, tax_country_code, vat_number, reverse_charge_flag). Can your billing system populate those tags in the XML and/or include them in the invoice PDF?

Also: do you support including a PO-number header and an explicit VAT breakdown line for EU customers?

Appreciate a short workplan and timeline so we can align internal testing.

Best,
Anya Petrov
Director, Finance Operations
Greenline Health

[Attachment: greenline_ap_spec.pdf (PDF)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options + VAT tagging (AP spec attached)

Hi Anya — thanks for sending the spec and the clear checklist. Looping in Connor (finance billing) and Marissa (billing ops) so we can propose a short rollout plan.

Short answers up front:
- Sender vs bill-to: We can emit the invoice from "Redwood Inference" as the invoice issuer and set the bill-to to whatever legal entity you prefer (we can map multiple bill-to/legal names per account). If you want the PO remit to control routing in your AP portal, include the remit_to_code in the PO and we'll echo it into the XML.
- Delivery channels: We support direct portal push (API/webhook) to several partners, secure SFTP transfer, and PDF email copies. Portal push + email copy is a common configuration for customers who want automated ingestion plus human verification.
- VAT tagging: Our invoice XML has fields for tax_country_code, vat_number, and a flags element where we can set reverse_charge_flag. We will need your expected XML mapping (your spec helped).

Proposed minimal workplan (timeline estimates):
1) Mapping confirmation (2 business days) — Greenline to confirm required XML tag names + sample PO format.
2) Test transport (3 business days) — we configure portal endpoint or SFTP and exchange test files.
3) Test invoice run (1 business day) — we issue a single test invoice (PDF + XML) for your ingestion.
4) Go-live (after successful UAT) — switch production routing, with email copies to ap@greenlinehealth.com.

I'll attach our sample invoice XML for Connor/Marissa to reference. Connor — can you confirm we can include the PO header on the invoice PDF and set an explicit VAT_breakdown element? Marissa — once we have mapping signed off, can you trigger a test transfer?

Thanks — I can jump on a 30-min call if that helps.

—
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

[Attachment: redwood_invoice_xml_sample.xml (XML)]

From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Anya Petrov <anya.petrov@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery options + VAT tagging (AP spec attached)

On Thu, May 10, 2028 at 9:48 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Proposed minimal workplan (timeline estimates):
> 1) Mapping confirmation (2 business days) — Greenline to confirm required XML tag names + sample PO format.

Thanks, Kim. Quick technical notes from finance/billing:
- VAT breakdown: we can include line-level tax_amount and a summary block (VAT_breakdown) that lists tax_rate, taxable_base, and tax_amount per rate. We will also include total_tax in the header.
- PO handling: we'll include an InvoiceHeader > BuyerPO element and we can set a custom header X-PO-HASH if you want machine-checked matching.
- remit_to_code: we'll echo your remit_to_code into InvoiceHeader > RemitCode so your portal can route.
- reverse_charge_flag: we'll set a boolean element reverseCharge="true|false" and also include narrative on the PDF ("Reverse charge: customer liable").

To complete mapping we need:
1) Example PO payload from Greenline (sample JSON or XML).
2) Confirm desired delivery endpoint: API URL + auth method or SFTP credentials.
3) Remittance address and VAT registration name for the bill-to entity.

I've prepared a short mapping file (see attachment) with Redwood XML tags matched to your field names; Marissa will handle the transport config.

Connor Obrien
Manager, Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

[Attachment: redwood_to_greenline_mapping.json (JSON mapping stub)]

Thanks all — this looks good. Greenline confirms the following:

• Delivery: portal push to our ingestion endpoint + PDF email copy to ap@greenlinehealth.com (we'll send API auth details).
• Sender: Redwood Inference as issuer; bill-to should be "Greenline Health LLC" with VAT 998-77-554 (we'll provide remittance address).
• PO format: we'll send an example UBL-JSON PO and the remit_to_code value we'll use for routing.

Marissa — please let us know next steps for scheduling the transport test (we can do Monday morning PDT).

Appreciate the quick turn.

Anya
